Method of Attack: Fake ransomware impersonating a JPG image file that drops multiple executables and a batch file to establish persistence, rename files to generic names, drop ransom notes demanding Bitcoin payment, and attempt to delete files on system drives (wiper behavior).
Uses fake encryption as a decoy while deleting almost all files on drives except C:\ (if naming error fixed).
Connects to a malicious URL to download additional payload.
Attack Vector: Malicious adult websites prompting users to download a disguised executable file (SexyPhotos.JPG.exe) via social engineering.
User double-clicking the file due to hidden file extensions.
Indicators of Compromise: Dropped files: del.exe, open.exe, windll.exe, windowss.exe, avtstart.bat, windows.bat, open.bat, Readme.txt
